subject.title: [Bug]: failed image attachment loads are silently dropped from the model prompt — model answers as if no image was sent

question: Which visible contract should OpenClaw use when native prompt-image loading fails before provider dispatch?
rationale: The root cause is narrow, but the durable fix changes model-visible text, user/operator diagnostics, log level, path disclosure, and multiple caller surfaces.

options.title: Add redacted prompt markers
options.body: Return skipped-image metadata and have embedded, CLI, and harness callers add a safe model-visible marker/count without full local paths.

options.title: Emit user-facing diagnostics only
options.body: Notify the user or operator that attached images failed to load while leaving the model prompt unchanged.

options.title: Fail the current turn
options.body: Treat current-turn image attachment load failures as input errors, which is clearer but may break optional prompt-reference workflows.

recommendation.title: Add redacted prompt markers
recommendation.body: Return skipped-image metadata and have embedded, CLI, and harness callers add a safe model-visible marker/count without full local paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The current shared prompt-image path and recent harness/CLI image work are most directly tied to this owner history.
